Yumeno Usami

UTAUloid · character profile

Yumeno is the sunny half of the pair. She wears oversized sleeves and fluffy leg warmers, ties her puffy twin-tails with white ribbons and greets everyone with a huge grin.

Jitsuno Usari

UTAUloid · character profile

Jitsuno is Yumeno's opposite. Her hair hangs over her face, her eyes are tearing up and a bandage sits on her cheek. She still wears bows and a soft lavender dress.

Terms of use

Everyone can use these voicebanks, Yumeno Usami and Jitsuno Usari, for any content. The only rule is to not cross the line and to not involve the voices in unwanted drama. The art can be reposted under these same terms.

How to install

  1. Download the zip file for the voice you want.
  2. Open OpenUtau and drag the zip onto its window, or use its Install Singer option.
  3. Choose the voice as the singer on your track.
Yumeno Usami and Jitsuno Usari are original characters. The art can be reposted under the same terms as the voicebanks.
